tool_schemas.name: get_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored GitLab projects visible through the optional connection scope and returns a page of projects ordered by the requested sort/order; pagination uses an opaque cursor and returns up to limit items per page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if filters/sort/order/limit/cursor are invalid or connection_id does not match the expected format. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the referenced connection’s mirror, and NOT_FOUND if the connection_id is well-formed but does not exist.

connection_id.description: GitLab connection id to scope the mirrored projects.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against project name or path_with_namespace.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_open_merge_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists open merge requests for a mirrored project, returning up to limit merge requests per page with an opaque cursor for pagination and optional filters (author, draft, mirror status, search) and sorting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is missing/invalid or if any filter/sort/order/limit/cursor is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller does not have access to the project’s mirror.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id to list merge requests for.

author_username.description: Filter merge requests by author username.

status.description: Filter merge requests by mirror sync status.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against merge request title.

limit.description: Maximum number of merge requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort.description: Field to sort merge requests by.

tool_schemas.name: get_merge_request_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single merge request from the mirror for the given project, identified by either merge_request_id or gitlab_mr_iid, and returns its metadata (e.g., title, branches, web_url, sync fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid, if both identifiers are missing, or if gitlab_mr_iid is out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or if no merge request with the provided identifier exists within that project, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the project mirror.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

tool_schemas.name: get_merge_request_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists discussion notes (general and/or diff notes) for a merge request from the mirror, returning up to limit notes per page and an opaque cursor for pagination with optional filters (type, discussion, author, resolved, system, sync status) and sorting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid, if neither merge_request_id nor gitlab_mr_iid is provided, or if any filter/sort/order/limit/cursor is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or merge request cannot be found in the mirror, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the project mirror.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

discussion_id.description: Filter notes by GitLab discussion id.

resolved.description: Filter notes by resolved state (typically for diff discussions).

system.description: Filter system notes (true) vs user notes (false).

status.description: Filter notes by local sync status.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: add_merge_request_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new general merge-request note for the specified merge request, persists it locally with outbound-sync status tracking, and returns the created note record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid, body is empty, or if neither merge_request_id nor gitlab_mr_iid is provided. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or merge request does not exist in the mirror, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access or comment on the project via the configured connection, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits for the integration are exceeded.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

body.description: Markdown body of the general merge request comment.

tool_schemas.name: add_merge_request_diff_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new diff-position note on a merge request (anchored by line_code and/or a GitLab position payload), persists it locally with outbound-sync status tracking, and returns the created note record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid, body is empty, if neither merge_request_id nor gitlab_mr_iid is provided, or if the supplied diff location (diff_file_id/line_code/position) is malformed or insufficient to place a diff note. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project/merge request (or referenced diff_file_id when provided) does not exist in the mirror, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access or comment via the configured connection, CONFLICT if the target diff context cannot accept a note (e.g., outdated/unsupported position), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

body.description: Markdown body of the diff comment.

diff_file_id.description: Local mirrored diff/file id the comment applies to.

line_code.description: GitLab line_code identifying the line in the diff to comment on.

position.description: GitLab diff position payload used to place the note on a specific line.

tool_schemas.name: get_merge_request_diff
tool_schemas.description: Lists mirrored diff files for a merge request, returning up to limit diff entries per page with an opaque cursor for pagination and optional filtering by current-ness, mirror status, and path, plus sorting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid, if neither merge_request_id nor gitlab_mr_iid is provided, or if any filter/sort/order/limit/cursor is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or merge request does not exist in the mirror, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the project mirror.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

is_current.description: If provided, filter diffs to only current (true) or non-current (false) files.

path.description: Filter by file path (matches old_path or new_path).

limit.description: Maximum number of diff files to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_issue_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single issue from the mirror by project_id and GitLab issue_iid and returns its stored issue fields (e.g., title, state, description, web_url, sync fields). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid or issue_iid is missing/out of range. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or the issue IID is not present in the mirror for that project, and UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the project mirror.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the issue.

tool_schemas.name: set_merge_request_description
tool_schemas.description: Updates the description of a mirrored merge request, records an outbound update with status tracking for eventual sync to GitLab, and returns the updated merge request record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if merge_request_id is invalid or if the description payload fails validation. Raises NOT_FOUND if merge_request_id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot update the merge request via the configured connection, CONFLICT if the merge request is in a state that refuses metadata updates, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are exceeded.

merge_request_id.description: Local mirror merge request id (merge_requests.id) to update.

description.description: New merge request description to set.

tool_schemas.name: set_merge_request_title
tool_schemas.description: Set the title of a merge request

merge_request_id.description: Local mirror merge request id (merge_requests.id) to update.

title.description: New merge request title to set.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single mirrored GitLab project by local project_id and returns its metadata and mirror status fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if no project exists for the active connection. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access the active connection.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: sync_project
tool_schemas.description: Triggers a best-effort sync of a mirrored project from GitLab into the local mirror (project metadata and recent merge requests), updating last_synced_at and transitioning related entities through syncing->active or syncing->error. Returns the project after scheduling/performing the sync. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist for the active connection, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot use the active connection, and RATE_LIMITED if the per-connection GitLab request budget is exceeded.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id to sync.

mode.description: Controls how much data is refreshed: lazy refreshes only required metadata; full refreshes project and merge-request lists/diffs where applicable.

tool_schemas.name: sync_merge_request
tool_schemas.description: Forces a refresh of a single merge request (and optionally its current diffs and notes) from GitLab into the local mirror, transitioning status to syncing then to active or error. Returns the refreshed merge request row. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the merge request does not exist in the specified project, and RATE_LIMITED if the per-connection GitLab request budget is exceeded.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

merge_request_id.description: Local mirrored merge request id (alternative to gitlab_mr_iid).

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

include_diffs.description: If true, refreshes the current diff snapshot for the merge request.

include_notes.description: If true, refreshes discussion notes for the merge request.

tool_schemas.name: update_merge_request
tool_schemas.description: Updates merge request metadata (title and/or description) in the local mirror and attempts to persist the change back to GitLab with status tracking. On GitLab failure, transitions mirror status to error and reverts the local change or marks it stale according to service consistency policy. Returns the updated merge request row. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if no fields are provided, NOT_FOUND if the merge request cannot be resolved, and RATE_LIMITED if the per-connection GitLab request budget is exceeded.

project_id.description: Local mirrored project id containing the merge request.

merge_request_id.description: Local mirrored merge request id (alternative to gitlab_mr_iid).

gitlab_mr_iid.description: GitLab per-project merge request IID (alternative to merge_request_id).

title.description: New merge request title to set.

description.description: New merge request description to set.

tool_schemas.name: retry_note_delivery
tool_schemas.description: Retries delivery of a previously failed or pending note to GitLab. Transitions notes.status from failed->pending_create->synced on success (or keeps/sets failed on error), and returns the updated note row. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if note_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the note does not exist for the active connection, CONFLICT if the note is deleted, and RATE_LIMITED if the per-connection GitLab request budget is exceeded.

note_id.description: Local mirrored note id to retry.

metadata.name: GitLab Merge Request Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores a local, queryable mirror of GitLab projects, merge requests, issues, diffs, and discussion notes to support an integration that can list and fetch MR/issue data and create/update MR comments and metadata. The main workflow is: sync or lazy-fetch GitLab entities into local tables
